title: edilint JSON report, version 3
description: The document `edilint --json` (equivalently `--output json`) writes: one run report covering every file linted in one invocation. The `version` field is incremented, and a new schema file committed, whenever a consumer written against the previous version could meet something it has not seen before.

version.description: The document shape version. This schema describes version 3.

files.description: One report per input file, in the order the files were given. Always an array, [] when no file could be read.

report.description: The result of linting one input.

file.description: The input path as given, "-" for standard input.

format.description: The detected or forced structural family of the input.

findings.description: The findings retained for display, ordered by position. Always an array, [] for a clean file. When summary.truncated is true this holds fewer findings than summary.total.

finding.description: A single defect located in an input file.

rule.description: The stable dotted rule name, e.g. "envelope.segment-count".

class.description: The leading component of the rule name, e.g. "envelope".

file.description: The input path, repeated on each finding so one finding is self-contained.

line.description: The 1-based physical line the defect starts on. Absent for whole-file findings.

column.description: The 1-based rune column within the line.

record_number.description: The 1-based logical record (or X12 segment) ordinal.

record.description: The kind of record: the segment identifier for X12 and HL7v2, the record type otherwise. Absent when the leading field holds data rather than a record-type discriminator.

code_point.description: The offending character for character findings, e.g. "U+0410".

expected.description: The declared side of a count, length or padding mismatch.

actual.description: The observed side of a count, length or padding mismatch.

summary.description: Finding counts for one file. Always reflects the complete set, including findings counted but not retained for display.

by_rule.description: Finding counts keyed by rule name. Absent for a clean file.

truncated.description: Present and true when the findings array was capped. The counts in this summary are exact either way.

runSummary.description: Finding counts aggregated over every file in the run.

truncated.description: Present and true when any file's findings array was capped.
